thread:
Priya: Escalating INC-7123 from AcmeCorp — they started getting intermittent 401s for SAML logins after an IdP attribute change. Also: provisioning jobs show KMS unwrap failures and audit logs for 2025-12-02 14:00-14:20 UTC are missing from the tenant export. Customer is asking for evidence for compliance.

Raj: On it. Do we have repro steps + exact request IDs? Can you paste the KMS/HSM error lines?

Priya: Paste below from their provisioning job (sanitized):
```
2025-12-02T14:03:12Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt failed tenant=acme job_id=job-84f7a
kms.unwrap: status=FAILED code=0xA3 message="HSM unwrap error: session lost"
retrying (1/3)
2025-12-02T14:03:13Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt failed tenant=acme job_id=job-84f7a
kms.unwrap: status=FAILED code=0xA3 message="HSM unwrap error: session lost"
```
They also report SAML 401s with the IdP changing `eduPersonAffiliation` -> `group` attribute.

Miguel: :eyes: I can repro the KMS unwrap locally against the staging HSM emulator by replaying the job. Will run `redwoodctl run-provision --tenant acme --job job-84f7a --debug` and attach logs.

sre-bot: New run started: run-20251202-01, provisioning debug enabled.

Miguel: Logs from the replay (sanitized):
```
[DEBUG] handshake -> HSM session established
[DEBUG] send unwrap request key=arn:redwood:kms:acme:key/abc123
[ERROR] HSM_RESP: ERR_CODE=0xA3, ERR_MSG="session dropped during unwrap"
[WARN] falling back to retry path
```
Looks like transient HSM session disconnects causing unwrap to fail and provisioning to abort, which leaves partially-created service principals (shadow service-accounts) in SCIM.

Raj: That explains the orphaned roles the customer mentioned. We need three things: reproduce window, collect KMS/HSM audit stream, and provide retention/audit evidence for compliance. Camille, can security sign off on exposing HSM logs to customer legal?

Camille: We can't share raw HSM logs, but we can produce an audited export with redacted fields and the KMS audit entries (tenant-scoped) plus an attestation record. I need the exact UTC window and request IDs. Also: did the customer request any data retention proof or timeline for audit export?

Priya: They asked for proof that we retained audit logs for the 14:00–14:20 UTC window and for an explanation of why provisioning created extra service accounts. They also asked for timeline and whether keys were ever exposed.

Raj: Action plan: 1) Infra to pull KMS audit stream for tenant `acme` between 2025-12-02T13:50 and 2025-12-02T14:30 (include request IDs). 2) Run repro in staging with HSM tracing enabled and capture correlation IDs. 3) SCIM reconciliation to remove orphaned service accounts and provide a list for customer review. 4) Provide attestation and redacted HSM audit extract via secure share.

Miguel: I ran a quick SCIM query: `GET /scim/v2/ServiceUsers?filter=externalId sw "job-84f7a"` and returned 3 partial entries with state=inactive. I can export IDs: `svc-901, svc-902, svc-903`.

Priya: Noted. Customer expects a remediation timeline today EOD.

Camille: I'll prepare the attestation template. Security needs the raw correlation IDs from the infra pull to match to HSM audit. Raj, can you assign infra-oncall?

Raj: Paging @infra-oncall — please pull KMS audit for tenant acme for 2025-12-02T13:50..2025-12-02T14:30 UTC, include all unwrap/unwrap-retry events, HSM session errors, and correlation IDs. Also confirm if any KMS key rotation happened near that time.

infra-oncall (Raj): Acknowledge. Starting pull now. Estimated 30m.

sre-bot: Audit pull started: audit-pull-20251202-acme by infra-oncall.

Priya: Also, follow-up item: the customer changed the SAML attribute mapping; can we confirm whether our SSO connector rejected the new `group` attribute causing 401s, or if provisioning failures caused downstream auth state drift? Need a root-cause narrative.

Miguel: From the traces I saw, some sessions failed SAML assertion verification (missing required `eduPersonAffiliation`) while others failed later during provisioning because the service account wasn't fully created due to unwrap failure. So two parallel failures: IdP mismatch -> direct 401s; and KMS unwrap -> provisioning partial state -> subsequent 401 when application tried to use the incomplete service account.

Camille: That matches an attack surface assessment concern: partial identity objects can create auth/z gaps. Recommend we include a short mitigation: 1) Enforce transactional SCIM create (atomic) for service principals, 2) add HSM unwrap retry/backoff metrics and alert on code 0xA3 spikes, 3) least-privilege review for the impacted keys.

Raj: I'll file infra ticket INFRA-3245 to adjust unwrap retry/backoff and alerting, and SCIM transactional change as a follow-on. For now: immediate remediation = remove the 3 inactive service users, rerun provisioning after rollback to prior IdP mapping, and provide the customer an incident timeline + attestation.

Priya: Customer asked about billing — they saw a spike due to repeated provisioning retries. Can finance provide a credit estimate for the token/operation usage?

Raj: Tagging @finance-ops. Miguel, please include the exact retry counts and approximate cost per-provision attempt in the run logs.

Miguel: From the debug run: 3 retries per unwrap, ~2 provisioning attempts per user, total ~9 extra operations. I'll estimate cost and post in the ticket.

Camille: For compliance evidence: once infra provides the redacted audit extract and we match correlation IDs, security will sign the attestation. Then support can share via secure customer share (SFTP link).

Priya: Thanks team. I'll update AcmeCorp with the remediation plan and ETA EOD. Keeping this thread pinned to INC-7123.

sre-bot: Incident INC-7123 status -> escalated -> security review requested.

Raj: Follow-ups: INFRA-3245 (unwrap alerts + retries), SEC-1098 (attestation template + audit extraction), TICKET-INC-7123 (customer communication + SCIM cleanup). Will update here when audit extract is uploaded. :thumbsup:

Priya: Closing loop for now, will post customer acknowledgement later.
